impact.en: Below-normal rainfall expected; early signs of dry conditions
impact.sw: Mvua chini ya wastani zinatarajiwa; dalili za awali za ukavu

en: Please follow TMA seasonal forecasts and advice from extension officers.
Households: use water carefully and keep a food reserve.
Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review drought contingency plans and update the list of people with special needs.
sw: Tafadhali fuatilieni utabiri wa msimu wa TMA na ushauri wa maafisa ugani.
Kaya: tumieni maji kwa uangalifu na wekeni akiba ya chakula.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura ya ukame na boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum.

impact.en: Low soil moisture affecting germination of crops
impact.sw: Unyevu mdogo wa udongo kuathiri uotaji wa mazao

en: Farmers are advised to plant drought-tolerant crops such as sorghum, millet and cassava.
Use mulch to keep moisture in the soil.
Plant with the first reliable rains, as advised by extension officers.
sw: Wakulima mnashauriwa kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame kama mtama, uwele na mihogo.
Tumieni matandazo kuhifadhi unyevu udongoni.
Pandeni kwa mvua za kwanza za uhakika, kwa ushauri wa maafisa ugani.

impact.en: Some pasture loss in grazing areas
impact.sw: Upungufu wa malisho katika baadhi ya maeneo ya kuchungia

en: Livestock keepers: store crop residues and hay.
Agree reserve grazing areas with Village leaders.
Consider selling some animals early while they are in good condition.
sw: Wafugaji: hifadhini mabaki ya mazao na nyasi kavu.
Kubalianeni maeneo ya akiba ya malisho na viongozi wa Kijiji.
Fikirieni kuuza baadhi ya mifugo mapema ikiwa bado ina afya nzuri.

impact.en: Reduced flow in rivers and streams
impact.sw: Kupungua kwa mtiririko wa maji mitoni na vijitoni

en: Please use water sparingly at home and on farms.
Protect water sources from animals and waste.
Report drying water sources to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Tafadhali tumieni maji kwa uangalifu nyumbani na mashambani.
Lindeni vyanzo vya maji dhidi ya mifugo na taka.
Toeni taarifa ya vyanzo vya maji vinavyokauka kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Falling water levels in small dams and ponds
impact.sw: Kupungua kwa kina cha maji katika mabwawa madogo na malambo

en: Harvest rainwater from roofs wherever possible.
Water user groups and RUWASA: repair broken boreholes and wells.
sw: Vuneni maji ya mvua kutoka kwenye paa pale inapowezekana.
Vikundi vya watumiaji maji na RUWASA: karabatini visima vilivyoharibika.

impact.en: Rising demand for water for irrigation and livestock
impact.sw: Kuongezeka kwa mahitaji ya maji kwa umwagiliaji na mifugo

en: Use water-saving irrigation methods.
Farmers and livestock keepers: agree water-sharing times with Village leaders.
Report water disputes to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Tumieni njia za umwagiliaji zinazookoa maji.
Wakulima na wafugaji: kubalianeni ratiba za kugawana maji na viongozi wa Kijiji.
Toeni taarifa ya migogoro ya maji kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Poorer quality of available water
impact.sw: Kushuka kwa ubora wa maji yanayopatikana

en: Boil drinking water or treat it with chlorine tablets.
Cover stored water.
Report cases of diarrhoea to the nearest health facility.
sw: Chemsheni maji ya kunywa au yatibuni kwa vidonge vya klorini.
Funikeni maji yaliyohifadhiwa.
Toeni taarifa ya wagonjwa wa kuhara kwenye kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

impact.en: Higher risk for children, older persons, pregnant women and people with disabilities
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa watoto, wazee, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu

en: Please share this advisory with neighbours, especially households with young children and older persons.
Health workers: begin nutrition screening of children under five.
sw: Tafadhali wapatieni taarifa hii majirani, hasa kaya zenye watoto wadogo na wazee.
Watoa huduma za afya: anzeni uchunguzi wa lishe kwa watoto walio chini ya miaka mitano.

impact.en: Early weight loss in livestock
impact.sw: Mifugo kuanza kupungua uzito

en: Give supplementary feed and clean water.
Vaccinate livestock as advised by livestock officers.
Consider early sale of weaker animals.
sw: Toeni chakula cha ziada na maji safi kwa mifugo.
Chanjeni mifugo kwa ushauri wa maafisa mifugo.
Fikirieni kuuza mapema mifugo dhaifu.

impact.en: Pressure on shared boreholes and wells
impact.sw: Msongamano katika visima vya pamoja

en: Agree water-collection schedules with neighbours.
Report broken pumps to the water authority or RUWASA.
sw: Kubalianeni ratiba za kuchota maji na majirani.
Toeni taarifa ya pampu zilizoharibika kwa mamlaka ya maji au RUWASA.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and extension officers.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na maafisa ugani.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Significant rainfall deficit in many areas
impact.sw: Upungufu mkubwa wa mvua katika maeneo mengi

en: District and Ward Disaster Management Committees: meet, activate drought contingency plans and report needs to the Regional Committee.
Please share water- and food-saving advice through radio, community meetings and places of worship.
sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya na Kata: kutaneni, amilisheni mipango ya dharura ya ukame na wasilisheni mahitaji kwa Kamati ya Mkoa.
Tafadhali sambazeni ushauri wa kutunza maji na chakula kupitia redio, mikutano ya jamii na nyumba za ibada.

impact.en: Crop stress and reduced harvests
impact.sw: Mazao kudhoofika na kupungua kwa mavuno

en: Farmers are advised to harvest what is mature and store it safely.
Extension officers: advise on managing remaining crops and on drought-tolerant seed.
Village Committees: assess household food stocks.
sw: Wakulima mnashauriwa kuvuna mazao yaliyokomaa na kuyahifadhi vizuri.
Maafisa ugani: toeni ushauri wa kutunza mazao yaliyobaki na mbegu zinazostahimili ukame.
Kamati za Vijiji: fanyeni tathmini ya akiba ya chakula ya kaya.

impact.en: Water shortage for households and livestock
impact.sw: Uhaba wa maji kwa kaya na mifugo

en: Please use water first for drinking, cooking and hygiene.
Water user groups: agree fair sharing times at boreholes and shared sources.
District Committees: plan water delivery to the most affected villages.
sw: Tafadhali tumieni maji kwanza kwa kunywa, kupikia na usafi.
Vikundi vya watumiaji maji: kubalianeni ratiba za haki za kuchota maji visimani na vyanzo vya pamoja.
Kamati za Wilaya: pangeni usambazaji wa maji kwa vijiji vilivyoathirika zaidi.

impact.en: Pasture loss forcing livestock movement
impact.sw: Upungufu wa malisho unaolazimu mifugo kuhamishwa

en: Livestock keepers: move herds only along routes agreed with Village and District leaders.
District Committees: designate grazing areas and water points along livestock routes.
Give supplementary feed and minerals where possible.
sw: Wafugaji: hamisheni mifugo kupitia njia zilizokubaliwa na viongozi wa Kijiji na Wilaya tu.
Kamati za Wilaya: tengeni maeneo ya malisho na vituo vya maji kwenye njia za mifugo.
Toeni chakula cha ziada na madini pale inapowezekana.

impact.en: Falling water levels in dams, reservoirs and rivers
impact.sw: Kupungua kwa kina cha maji katika mabwawa na mito

en: Please avoid non-essential water use such as washing vehicles.
Water authorities: announce water-use schedules in good time.
sw: Tafadhali epukeni matumizi ya maji yasiyo ya lazima kama kuosha magari.
Mamlaka za maji: tangazeni ratiba za matumizi ya maji mapema.

impact.en: Possible reduction in hydropower and power supply
impact.sw: Uwezekano wa kupungua kwa uzalishaji wa umeme wa maji

en: Please switch off appliances and lights that are not needed.
Follow announcements from TANESCO.
sw: Tafadhali zimeni vifaa na taa zisizohitajika.
Fuatilieni matangazo ya TANESCO.

impact.en: Rising food prices in local markets
impact.sw: Kupanda kwa bei za vyakula masokoni

en: Households: avoid selling food reserves needed for your own family.
Report unusual price rises to Village/Mtaa leaders.
District Committees: monitor market prices and report to the Regional Committee.
sw: Kaya: epukeni kuuza akiba ya chakula inayohitajika na familia.
Toeni taarifa ya kupanda kwa bei kusiko kwa kawaida kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Kamati za Wilaya: fuatilieni bei za masoko na toeni taarifa kwa Kamati ya Mkoa.

impact.en: Movement of pastoralists in search of water and pasture
impact.sw: Kuhama kwa wafugaji kutafuta maji na malisho

en: Pastoralists: inform Village leaders before entering a new area.
Farmers and pastoralists: please resolve disputes through Village leaders.
District Committees: coordinate movement with neighbouring districts.
sw: Wafugaji: wajulisheni viongozi wa Kijiji kabla ya kuingia eneo jipya.
Wakulima na wafugaji: tafadhali tatueni migogoro kupitia viongozi wa Kijiji.
Kamati za Wilaya: ratibuni uhamaji na wilaya jirani.

impact.en: Weakness and disease in livestock
impact.sw: Mifugo kudhoofika na kupata magonjwa

en: Report sick or dying animals to livestock officers.
Consider selling weak animals before they lose more value.
District livestock officers: deploy mobile veterinary teams.
sw: Toeni taarifa ya mifugo inayougua au kufa kwa maafisa mifugo.
Fikirieni kuuza mifugo dhaifu kabla thamani yake haijashuka zaidi.
Maafisa mifugo wa Wilaya: pelekeni timu za huduma za mifugo za mkoba.

impact.en: Increased diarrhoea from unsafe water
impact.sw: Kuongezeka kwa kuhara kutokana na maji yasiyo salama

en: Boil drinking water or treat it with chlorine tablets.
Give ORS at the first sign of diarrhoea and go to a health facility.
District Committees: distribute water-treatment tablets to affected villages.
sw: Chemsheni maji ya kunywa au yatibuni kwa vidonge vya klorini.
Tumieni ORS dalili za kuhara zinapoanza na nendeni kituo cha afya.
Kamati za Wilaya: sambazeni vidonge vya kutibu maji kwa vijiji vilivyoathirika.

impact.en: Children missing school to fetch water
impact.sw: Watoto kukosa masomo ili kutafuta maji

en: Parents: please keep children in school.
School heads: report water shortages at schools to the District Education Office.
sw: Wazazi: tafadhali hakikisheni watoto wanaendelea na masomo.
Wakuu wa shule: toeni taarifa ya uhaba wa maji shuleni kwa Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and extension officers.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na maafisa ugani.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Severe drought affecting whole districts or regions
impact.sw: Ukame mkali unaoathiri wilaya au mikoa mizima

en: Regional Committees: report the situation and needs to the Prime Minister's Office – Disaster Management Department.
District Committees: coordinate food, water, health and livestock support in every affected ward.
Please follow guidance from Disaster Management Committees and Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Kamati za Mikoa: wasilisheni hali na mahitaji kwa Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Idara ya Menejimenti ya Maafa.
Kamati za Wilaya: ratibuni msaada wa chakula, maji, afya na mifugo katika kila kata iliyoathirika.
Tafadhali fuateni maelekezo ya Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Crop failure and serious food shortage
impact.sw: Mazao kushindwa na upungufu mkubwa wa chakula

en: District Committees: distribute food assistance to households most in need, with NFRA and partners.
Village Committees: help identify households most in need of food assistance.
Please share available food with vulnerable neighbours.
sw: Kamati za Wilaya: sambazeni msaada wa chakula kwa kaya zenye uhitaji zaidi, kwa kushirikiana na NFRA na wadau.
Kamati za Vijiji: saidieni kutambua kaya zenye uhitaji mkubwa wa msaada wa chakula.
Tafadhali shirikianeni chakula kilichopo na majirani walio hatarini.

impact.en: Large numbers of livestock dying
impact.sw: Vifo vya idadi kubwa ya mifugo

en: Livestock officers: support sale or slaughter of weak animals before they die.
Deliver emergency feed and water to remaining animals.
Please bury or burn carcasses away from water sources.
sw: Maafisa mifugo: saidieni uuzaji au uchinjaji wa mifugo dhaifu kabla haijafa.
Pelekeni chakula na maji ya dharura kwa mifugo iliyobaki.
Tafadhali zikeni au chomeni mizoga mbali na vyanzo vya maji.

impact.en: Severe shortage of drinking water
impact.sw: Uhaba mkubwa wa maji ya kunywa

en: District Committees and water authorities: deliver water to affected villages, health facilities and schools.
Please use water only for drinking, cooking and hygiene.
Report broken water points to RUWASA or the water authority.
sw: Kamati za Wilaya na mamlaka za maji: sambazeni maji kwa vijiji, vituo vya afya na shule zilizoathirika.
Tafadhali tumieni maji kwa kunywa, kupikia na usafi pekee.
Toeni taarifa ya vituo vya maji vilivyoharibika kwa RUWASA au mamlaka ya maji.

impact.en: Power rationing from reduced hydropower
impact.sw: Mgao wa umeme kutokana na kupungua kwa umeme wa maji

en: Follow TANESCO rationing schedules.
Health facilities and water pumps: keep back-up power ready.
sw: Fuateni ratiba za mgao wa umeme za TANESCO.
Vituo vya afya na pampu za maji: wekeni tayari vyanzo mbadala vya umeme.

impact.en: Sharp rise in food prices
impact.sw: Kupanda sana kwa bei za vyakula

en: Traders: please do not hoard food.
District Committees: monitor prices and report hoarding to the authorities.
Report unusual price rises to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Wafanyabiashara: tafadhali msilimbikize vyakula.
Kamati za Wilaya: fuatilieni bei na toeni taarifa ya ulimbikizaji kwa mamlaka.
Toeni taarifa ya kupanda kwa bei kusiko kwa kawaida kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Malnutrition, especially in children under five
impact.sw: Utapiamlo, hasa kwa watoto walio chini ya miaka mitano

en: Parents: take thin or weak children to the nearest health facility.
Health workers: screen children for malnutrition and treat severe cases.
Continue breastfeeding infants.
sw: Wazazi: wapelekeni watoto waliokonda au dhaifu kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Watoa huduma za afya: fanyeni uchunguzi wa utapiamlo kwa watoto na tibuni walioathirika sana.
Endeleeni kunyonyesha watoto wachanga.

impact.en: Families moving in search of water and food
impact.sw: Familia kuhama kutafuta maji na chakula

en: Please register with Village leaders on arrival in a new area.
District Committees: set up reception points with water, food and health services.
Protect women, children and older persons on the move.
sw: Tafadhali jiandikisheni kwa viongozi wa Kijiji mnapofika eneo jipya.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya mapokezi vyenye maji, chakula na huduma za afya.
Walindeni wanawake, watoto na wazee wanaohama.

impact.en: Heavy losses to farming and livestock livelihoods
impact.sw: Hasara kubwa kwa maisha yanayotegemea kilimo na mifugo

en: Report losses to Village/Mtaa leaders and extension officers.
Extension officers: assess crop and livestock losses.
sw: Toeni taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa na maafisa ugani.
Maafisa ugani: fanyeni tathmini ya hasara ya mazao na mifugo.

impact.en: Conflict with wildlife as herds enter protected areas
impact.sw: Migogoro na wanyamapori mifugo inapoingia maeneo ya hifadhi

en: Livestock keepers: please do not graze inside protected areas.
Report dangerous wild animals to TAWA or TANAPA.
District Committees, TAWA and TANAPA: agree temporary grazing areas outside protected areas.
sw: Wafugaji: tafadhali msichunge ndani ya maeneo ya hifadhi.
Toeni taarifa ya wanyamapori hatari kwa TAWA au TANAPA.
Kamati za Wilaya, TAWA na TANAPA: kubalianeni maeneo ya muda ya malisho nje ya hifadhi.

impact.en: National support required for food, water, nutrition and livestock
impact.sw: Msaada wa kitaifa unahitajika kwa chakula, maji, lishe na mifugo

en: Prime Minister's Office – Disaster Management Department: coordinate national support with ministries and partners.
District Committees: send regular situation reports through the Regional Committee.
sw: Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Idara ya Menejimenti ya Maafa: ratibuni msaada wa kitaifa pamoja na wizara na wadau.
Kamati za Wilaya: wasilisheni taarifa za hali mara kwa mara kupitia Kamati ya Mkoa.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please rely on official sources: radio, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the drought emergency has ended.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hali ya dharura ya ukame itakapomalizika.
